messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the RBAC rollout this morning SCIM provisioning started failing for several tenants, creating user sync gaps. Kicking off triage here.
kevin: any error samples?
maria: here's the most common stack snippet (redacted):
```
2026-03-21T08:16:22Z ERROR scim-provisioner apply_patch extID=github:1234 error=kms:Decrypt failed status=403 context="envelope header mismatch"
```
maria: also seeing 500s from idp-proxy when we try to bind SAML assertions to accounts — looks like SCIM and SSO failures are correlated.
olivia: @maria can you paste the idp Audience and our SP entityID? suspicious of audience or assertion changes after RBAC/attribute mapping updates.
maria: idp audience: https://idp.acme/callback
maria: our SP entityID: https://api.redwood.example/saml/consume
samir: quick note — we changed the SCIM primary key from email -> externalId in the RBAC rollout (CL-4582). Could be attribute mapping fallout rather than pure SAML audience mismatch.
sre_bot: Deploy bot: service/redwood-scim rolled back at 08:20 due to repeated 502s
kevin: can you grep the provisioning logs for 'AccessDeniedException' and 'ciphertext' and include the KMS key alias? need to know if it's KMS policy or IAM role missing.
maria: minimal log w/ headers:
```
ciphertext: "Ci..."
kms_key_alias: alias/redwood-scim
caller_identity: svc-scim@redwood
error: AccessDeniedException: Caller is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt
```
olivia: that AccessDenied usually points at either the KMS key policy not listing the principal ARN, or the IAM role missing kms:Decrypt in the policy. RBAC rename might have changed the principal.
maria: confirmed the service principal changed after the role rename: svc-scim-old -> svc-scim-new (service account id changed).
samir: is the key policy scoped to specific principal ARNs? If so we'll need to add svc-scim-new. Also check encryption context enforcement.
kevin: opening internal ticket and pinging infra-iam, referencing CL-4582 and the error logs. In the meantime, is there a safe fallback key with broader policy we can use for short window? risky but might be needed to reduce user impact.
maria: idp-bot: SCIM sync paused for tenant acme-corp due to repeated failures (auto-paused after 5 consecutive errs)
infra-iam: infra-iam: acknowledged, investigating key policy vs IAM role mapping now
kevin: @infra-iam when you check, please verify: (1) key policy includes the new principal ARN; (2) IAM role attached to svc-scim-new has kms:Decrypt for alias/redwood-scim; (3) encryption context in logs matches what KMS expects.
olivia: plan: (A) infra-iam add svc-scim-new to key policy if missing; (B) infra run a targeted decrypt test using svc-scim-new creds; (C) resume SCIM sync for paused tenants; (D) create regression test for externalId mapping fallback to email.
samir: +1 on regression tests. Also capture a snapshot of KMS key policy and SCIM attribute mapping before we change anything.
maria: I'll hold a brief war-room if infra-iam needs realtime help. Opening incident INC-2026-021 and linking logs + KMS policy snapshot and CL-4582.
kevin: thanks — I'll update here when infra-iam confirms policy change or if we need a short-lived fallback key.
infra-iam: infra-iam: key policy did not include svc-scim-new ARN; requested policy edit and will post audit diff once applied.
maria: leaving the thread pinned for the incident channel. thx all :thumbsup:
kevin: note for postmortem: add checklist item to coordinate RBAC role renames with KMS key policy updates and SCIM attr mapping changes.
